messages:
Jamie (CS Ops): Heads-up — noticed a steady pileup in the playbook-runner queue for staging. Some onboarding playbooks are delayed by ~20-40m. Can we triage? :eyes:
Ravi - Playbooks: Yep saw it too. Queue depth spiked after the nightly backfill job. Looks like the holdback gating check is slower now (cpu waits).
Ava - Onboarding: This is affecting a small cohort of new trials — a few folks didn't get the welcome sequence. Need a short mitigation while infra digs in.
Marta (Data): I can pull a sample of affected accounts. Quick query: `SELECT count(*) FROM playbook_runs WHERE status='queued' AND created_at > now() - interval '2 hours'` — that shows ~3.2k in staging.
Ravi - Playbooks: Thanks Marta. Can you add a group by playbook_type? want to see if it's concentrated.
Marta (Data): sure — results coming. Early signal: 70% are `onboard.welcome_v2` and `healthscore-init`.
Jamie (CS Ops): Proposed immediate mitigation: reduce concurrency for the nightly backfill worker and bump worker pool for realtime queue. Short rollback plan: 1) pause backfill ingest, 2) scale up realtime workers x2, 3) re-open backfill with throttled rate. Thoughts?
Ravi - Playbooks: +1. Also add a fallback: let playbook-runner skip expensive gating for accounts flagged `expedite_onboard=true` (small whitelist) so critical trials get immediate runs.
Ava - Onboarding: Can we only use expedite for accounts created last 72h? That keeps it narrowly scoped.
Ravi - Playbooks: yep limit to created_at > now()- interval '72 hours' and expedite flag. I can patch the runner config.
infra-bot: deploy triggered by @Ravi - Playbooks: `deploy/playbook-runner:hotfix-2026-03-21` — status: queued.
Jamie (CS Ops): Marta, can you share the list of top 100 affected customers so success can manually nudge? If it's too many we'll prioritize trials and accounts with trial_start within 7 days.
Marta (Data): exporting now. Posting a secure link in #sensitive shortly.
Ravi - Playbooks: Quick CLI to scale workers:```bash
# increase realtime pool
infra scale playbook-runner --env staging --pool realtime --replicas 6
# pause backfill
infra job pause nightly-backfill --env staging
```
Ava - Onboarding: ETA for manual nudges? I can mobilize 2 CS reps for the next 90 minutes.
Jamie (CS Ops): Good — do the nudges for high-value trials (>$1k ARR potential). I'll own coordination with product for a longer-term fix.
Ravi - Playbooks: Hotfix deployed and config patch applied to skip gating for expedite whitelist. Will monitor.
infra-bot: deploy `playbook-runner` to staging succeeded — 1m ago.
Marta (Data): After the scale and pause, queue depth trending down. Now ~450 queued.
Jamie (CS Ops): Nice. Follow-ups: (a) postmortem in #postmortems (assigning to @Ravi and @Infra), (b) add telemetry on gating latency per-playbook, (c) adjust backfill to use smaller shards.
Ravi - Playbooks: Adding a countermetric `playbook.gating_latency_ms` and a 95th/99th histogram. Will also add an alert if gating latency > 1.5s for >5m.
Ava - Onboarding: I'll document the manual nudge playbook and link the script in the CS runbook.
Marta (Data): Shared the export link in #sensitive and included a small CSV of top 200 accounts.
Jamie (CS Ops): Thanks everyone. If the queue bottoms out, we'll re-run a small simulated backfill to validate fixes. Marking this thread as resolved when metrics stable. :white_check_mark:
Ravi - Playbooks: Noted. I'll post the follow-up PR and incident note in #postmortems later today.
